authority: Owner must freeze this policy and the evaluation split before any final held-out measurement. This file is not fitted to observed held-out performance and contains no operating thresholds.

in_scope: event membership for approved multi-outlet comparison inputs
claim grouping and surface binding to the exact event and article identity
collection-aware abstention when evidence is insufficient
out_of_scope_until_separate_freeze: World View photorealism or physical-device rendering

error_categories.false_merge: Distinct events or identities treated as one.
error_categories.false_split: One event or claim treated as unrelated.
error_categories.wrong_relation_type: Sequence, allegation, or co-location promoted to a stronger relation.
error_categories.source_lineage_error: Copy/syndication treated as independent, or independent sources treated as copies.
error_categories.identity_substitution: Ticker, title, comparison event key, graph UUID or outlet name used as a different identity family.
error_categories.temporal_leakage: Evidence first observed later used in an as-known-then result.
error_categories.stale_current: Withdrawn or corrected support still presented as current.
error_categories.unsupported_confidence: A numeric or verbal confidence not licensed by retained evidence and coverage.
error_categories.false_retrieval: Irrelevant material retrieved and treated as support.

any_of_these_is_critical: false_merge of distinct real-world events after human adjudication
published current claim that is withdrawn or retracted in retained source history
identity_substitution that would attach evidence to the wrong actor, asset or place
treating implementation-agent labels or model agreement as independent ground truth
critical_error_rules.rule: Owner freezes the allowed critical-error count and whether a single critical error blocks release. This proposal recommends blocking release eligibility on any adjudicated critical error in the frozen held-out set. That recommendation is not an approved threshold.

measures.retrieval_recall: retrieved relevant / resolved relevant. Unresolved labels are excluded from the relevant denominator.
measures.retrieval_precision: retrieved relevant / retrieved resolved. Retrieved unresolved labels are counted separately and excluded from this denominator.
measures.useful_population_coverage: correct decisions / entire held-out population, including unresolved and abstentions.
measures.reporting_rule: Every ratio retains numerator and denominator. An empty denominator is null, not zero. Unresolved cases remain in coverage. Do not drop hard cases to improve apparent accuracy.

required_coverage_matrix: event membership: shared actor in distinct episodes; true paraphrase; broad topic versus one occurrence
claims: negation; 12 versus 120; attribution; modality; changed date/unit; correction versus contradiction
source lineage: exact copy; appended paragraph; wire attribution; partial reuse of one claim
retractions: corrected number; entity split; withdrawn support
historical discovery: late old document; new alias; dated supplier relation
surface consistency: event-to-News identity; Comparison explanation bound to its event
sample_requirements.rule: Choose sample size from required coverage and error bounds after owner freeze. Do not invent a universal N here and do not back-solve N from a desired score.

rules: Missing evidence is not contradicting evidence.
Nothing found in a bounded search is a bounded observation, not proof of absence.
Numeric confidence requires calibration against independently adjudicated held-out labels.
Implementation-agent scores and model-model agreement are not calibration labels.

leakage_protection.temporal_rule: development_until is strictly before heldout_from. Development observations cannot be after the development boundary; held-out observations cannot be before the held-out boundary.
leakage_protection.near_duplicate_rule: Declared duplicate groups and exact input hashes cannot cross partitions. The manifest cannot authenticate undisclosed near duplicates; residual leakage is a review limitation until owner-adjudicated duplicate discovery is complete.
leakage_protection.source_family_rule: Origin groups partition source families. Do not put the same retained source family on both sides of the freeze.

reference_label_protocol.ground_truth: independently adjudicated, source-grounded human labels accepted by the owner
human_adjudication_requires: source excerpts that exist in retained rights-cleared text; no invented bodies
the proposed relation or membership decision and its error category
a written rationale hashed into the adjudication record
an unresolved option that is first-class, not a discarded leftover

recommended_arrangement.primary: one human adjudicator per case using the retained source, not the model output
recommended_arrangement.critical_cases: second independent human adjudicator; disagreement stays unresolved until owner decision
recommended_arrangement.owner: accepts or rejects the adjudicated set as the reference-label freeze; this remains a separate owner decision
recommended_arrangement.blinding: adjudicators do not see model decisions or implementation-agent scores on first pass

distinctions.internal_candidate_generation: A worker may emit a generation-bound output.
distinctions.operational_correctness: Lease, acknowledgement, selection, withdrawal and correlation behave as specified.
distinctions.semantic_qualification: Adjudicated held-out measures under a frozen policy.
distinctions.release_eligibility: Owner decision after semantic qualification, publication/rights gates and cutover evidence. Not implied by the first three.
